.²1 Terrifying, frightening, intimidating.
.²2 Formidable, terrible.
.²3 Bullying or blustering (as language).

.²1 Terrifying.
.²2 A means of terrifying, terror.

<ab>N.</ab> of a demon and brother of Rāvaṇa. [Though a demon by
 birth, he was extremely sorry for the abduction of Sītā by Rāvaṇa,
 and severely reprimanded him for his wicked act. He several times advised
 Rāvaṇa to restore Sītā to Rāma if he cared to live; but the proud
 demon turned a deaf ear to his warnings. At last seeing that the ruin
 of his brother was inevitable, he repaired to Rāma and became his staunch
 friend. After the death of Rāvaṇa, Rāma installed him on the throne
 of Laṅkā. He is believed to be one of the seven Chirajīvins; see {#cirajIvin#}.]
